environment: Local WSL; isolated SQL sandbox; background workers disabled
correctness: Visible rows filtered before LIMIT; hidden newer rows do not hide older visible documents.
Exclusive cursor yields every original row once despite new appends.
Revocation and malformed cursors fail closed.
LiveView replaces the current page, preserves draft fields and its page on reconciliation.
Revoked views redirect after the upload channel has stopped; live uploads terminate with their owning view.
limitations: Decoded binary bytes are not wire bytes. Wall time includes observer overhead. No hosted run or capacity claim.
